scene mollytrain1
Today has been...eventful if nothing else.
lines.zh: 今天……别的不说，至少很充实。

lines.en: And while I’d like to take this time to pat myself on the back for not violating Molly, the day is not yet over.
lines.zh: 虽然我很想趁现在为自己没有侵犯 Molly 而自我表扬一番，可这一天还没结束。

lines.en: There is still plenty of time for me to make a horrible, impulsive decision that will, once again, lead me spiraling downward until the possibility of ever returning to the surface disappears once and for all.
lines.zh: 我还有大把时间，去做一个可怕而冲动的决定，再一次让我螺旋下坠，直到重新浮回水面的可能性彻底消失。

lines.en: She’s making it easier, though.
lines.zh: 不过她让这件事变容易了。

lines.en: Which is strange considering that everything she’s done today has been making something {i}else{/i} harder, but...I guess that was kind of the point.
lines.zh: 这挺奇怪的——考虑到她今天做的每一件事都在让{i}另一样{/i}东西变得更难——不过……我想那大概正是重点。

lines.en: Of course talking wouldn’t have a substantial effect on me when my experience with it is almost entirely impure.
lines.zh: 谈话当然不会对我有实质性影响，毕竟我跟它打交道的经验几乎全都是不纯洁的。

lines.en: But convincing me that I can do no wrong at this point plays right into my ego.
lines.zh: 可让我相信「我现在做什么都不会错」，正好迎合了我的自负。

lines.en: There was an experiment some twisted scientist did a long time ago where he or she would shock some sort of animal any time it went to take a bite of food.
lines.zh: 很久以前有个心理扭曲的科学家做过一个实验：每当某只动物要咬一口食物，他（或她）就电击它。

lines.en: Whatever that animal was became so scared of that food that it was forced to either starve itself or endure the shock in order to eat.
lines.zh: 那只动物变得如此害怕那份食物，以至于它被迫在饿死自己、和挨着电击进食之间二选一。

lines.en: It starved itself — which is precisely what I’m doing right now.
lines.zh: 它把自己饿死了——而这正是我现在在做的事。

lines.en: But the food has grown legs and keeps coming closer- and I am a natural predator who is not known for my ability to stave off temptation.
lines.zh: 可那份食物长了腿，还在不断靠近——而我是一个天生不以抵御诱惑著称的捕食者。

lines.en: I can only starve myself for so long before the urge to survive kicks in and I push through the preconceived pain to take what I want.
lines.zh: 我只能饿自己这么久——等到求生本能启动，我就会顶着预先设想好的痛楚，去拿走我想要的东西。

lines.en: All I ask is that you keep shocking me every now and then so I do not grow fat and complacent.
lines.zh: 我唯一的要求是，你时不时继续电我一下，免得我变得又肥又自满。

lines.en: And that you stop giving me my favorite treats.
lines.zh: 还有，别再给我我最爱吃的零食了。

lines.en: : I never realized just how packed these subway cars can get until I moved here.
lines.zh: : 搬到这儿来之前，我从来没意识到地铁车厢能挤成这样。

lines.en: : I’d seen rush hour depicted in anime and manga, but had always just assumed that things were being blown out of proportion as it wasn’t ever even {i}close{/i} to this where I’m from.
lines.zh: : 我在动画和漫画里见过高峰期的样子，可我一直以为那是夸张——因为我老家的情况跟这儿比{i}差得远{/i}了。

lines.en: : Do they have subways in Ireland?
lines.zh: : 爱尔兰有地铁吗？

lines.en: : There are commuter trains, but even the ones in busy places like Dublin are above ground.
lines.zh: : 有通勤火车，但就连都柏林那种繁忙地方的线路也在地面上。

lines.en: : Everyone just drove where I’m from. The population wasn’t dense enough to warrant anything like this.
lines.zh: : 我老家那儿大家都自己开车。人口密度根本够不上修这种东西。

lines.en: : Things may have been different the closer you got to the city but, being from a small town, things like packed subway cars stay kind of surprising no matter how many times I see or live through it.
lines.zh: : 越靠近城市也许会不一样，不过我从小镇出来，像挤成沙丁鱼罐头似的地铁车厢这种事，不管见过、经历过多少次，都还是让我有点惊讶。

lines.en: : Well, you’re doing a good job of blending in. If it weren’t for your appearance, I probably wouldn’t even realize you’re not from around here.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你融入得挺好。要不是看你的长相，我大概根本看不出你不是本地人。

lines.en: scene mollytrain2
: {i}Neither{/i} of us are doing a good job blending in since we’re the only ones talking right now, Sir.
lines.zh: : 可我们俩{i}都没{/i}融入好——因为现在整节车厢只有我们在说话，先生。

lines.en: : We’re supposed to mind our own business and quietly hate ourselves on the subway. That is one of the first things I learned when I moved here.
lines.zh: : 在地铁上，我们应该管好自己的事、安安静静地憎恨自己。这是我搬来之后最先学会的事情之一。

lines.en: : Why Kumon-mi anyway? Why not Tokyo or something? That seems to be the hub for most foreigners.
lines.zh: : 那为什么选 Kumon-mi？为什么不去东京什么的？那似乎是大多数外国人的聚集地。

lines.en: : Yes, which is precisely {i}why{/i} I didn’t move there. It would have been too easy, Sir.
lines.zh: : 对，这正是我没搬去那儿的{i}原因{/i}。那太容易了，先生。

lines.en: : Coming somewhere like Kumon-mi, where outsiders are extremely limited, was a way for me to challenge myself to become better.
lines.zh: : 来到 Kumon-mi 这种外来者极少的地方，是我挑战自己、让自己变得更好的一种方式。

lines.en: scene mollytrain3
: It would have been nice if they made it a {i}little{/i} easier for foreigners to find housing, though. Thank Mara for the dorms. Saves me from having to sleep in the sewers.
lines.zh: : 不过要是外国人找房子能{i}容易点{/i}就好了。感谢玛拉赐我宿舍。省得我睡下水道。

lines.en: : And who is Mara exactly?
lines.zh: : 玛拉到底是谁？

lines.en: : The goddess of love in the Imperial Pantheon of the Nine Divines.
lines.zh: : 是帝国九圣神系里的爱之女神。

lines.en: : Maybe choose one of the other eight since love hasn’t really seemed to be an area of success for you thus far.
lines.zh: : 也许你该选另外八位里的一个——毕竟到目前为止，爱情在你这儿似乎都不太成功。

lines.en: scene mollytrain4
: Thank you for reminding me, Sir. As if you hadn’t already done that an hour-
lines.zh: : 谢谢提醒，先生。好像您一小时前还没提醒过我似的——

lines.en: scene mollytrain5
: Ago?!
: Hey, come on. There’s plenty of room-
lines.zh: : 嘿，别这样。还有不少空间——

lines.en: : Shh!

lines.zh: : 哦天哪……我进到{i}那种{/i}游戏里了。

lines.en: scene mollytrain6
: Molly...sorry, but I-
lines.zh: : Molly……抱歉，可我——

lines.en: : Shh!
: What? You too?
lines.zh: : 什么？你也一样？

lines.en: : Don’t talk.
lines.zh: : 别说话。

lines.en: : And also, don’t move.
lines.zh: : 还有，别动。

lines.en: : In fact, don’t do anything.
lines.zh: : 事实上，什么都别做。

lines.en: : This is the part where you stay still and discreet or the game ends. I have experience. Trust me.
lines.zh: : 这就是你该保持不动、不引人注目的部分，否则游戏就结束了。我有经验。相信我。

lines.en: : Uhh...
scene mollytrain7
: Just...have to make it to the end of the first level. That’s all. Should be easy.
lines.zh: : 只要……撑到第一关结束就行。就这些。应该很简单。

lines.en: : Are you-
lines.zh: : 你在——

lines.en: : Shh. Focusing.
lines.zh: : 嘘。在集中精神。

lines.en: The cage opens and my meal is, once again, placed on an electric panel.
lines.zh: 笼子打开了，而我的食物又一次被放上了电击板。

lines.en: scene mollytrain8
I come to understand her pleas for stillness as I gaze downward and find that our position is one of common concern when train passengers are packed in like sardines.
lines.zh: 我低下头，明白了她恳求我别动的原因——当乘客像沙丁鱼一样挤在一起时，我们这个姿势属于那种常见的困扰。

lines.en: And while I know Molly to not be the type to cry about me being a groper or anything like that, it is now impossible for me to think of anything other than a forced connection I can not escape from.
lines.zh: 虽然我知道 Molly 不是那种会因为我成了痴汉就大喊大叫的人，可我现在已经没法去想别的事了——除了这段我无法挣脱的、被强行建立的连接。

lines.en: Several others press against my back and move me forward- which moves {i}her{/i} forward as well. But she has nowhere else to go as she’s already firmly up against the door.
lines.zh: 好几个人压在我背上把我往前推——也就把{i}她{/i}往前推。可她已经牢牢贴在门上，没有别的地方可去。

lines.en: Molly attempts to resist regardless by nudging what little of her body she’s still able to control backward, but that creates an even more immediate problem as it just leads to her grinding against me.
lines.zh: Molly 还是试图抵抗，把她还能控制的那一丁点身体往后挪，可这反而制造了一个更直接的问题——结果只是让她在我身上磨蹭。

lines.en: That, paired with the vibration of the train as it moves along its tracks and an echo chamber built to amplify the breathing of those trapped within it-
lines.zh: 再配上列车沿轨道行驶时的震动，以及这个仿佛专门用来放大被困其中者呼吸声的回音室——

lines.en: I am faced with my hardest challenge yet.
lines.zh: 我面临了迄今为止最难的关卡。

lines.en: And am now just seconds away from allowing myself to be shocked.
lines.zh: 而现在，再过几秒我就要放任自己挨那一下电击了。

lines.en: scene mollytrain9
: {i}Shh!{/i}
scene mollytrain10

lines.en: The harder Molly resists being forced up against the glass, the stronger the connection between us grows.
lines.zh: Molly 越是抵抗被压向那扇玻璃门，我们之间的联系就越强。

lines.en: The tightness of her shorts and the fact that I was circumstantially forced into having an erection make it nearly impossible for me to hold myself back from pressing harder into her.

lines.en: And I can feel it even more when she adjusts and angles herself so I’m caught firmly between her cheeks.
lines.zh: 而当她调整姿势、把我牢牢夹在她的两瓣之间时，我感觉得更清楚。

lines.en: scene mollytrain11
She moves.
lines.zh: 她动了。

lines.en: So do I.
lines.zh: 我也动了。

lines.en: How apt that the world itself would be the one to force us together when neither one of us has had the willpower or resolve to move forward on our own.
lines.zh: 多贴切啊——当我们俩谁都没有足够的意志或决心自己往前走时，反倒是世界本身把我们推到了一起。

lines.en: Molly has tried, which is why she’s moving more than I am now.
lines.zh: Molly 试过，所以现在她动得比我多。

lines.en: Which is why she’s pressing back against me with more fervor than before.

lines.en: Which is why I can feel her body burning up.

lines.en: Which is why I can see the glass in front of her beginning to turn white with fog.

lines.en: Which is why I grow harder.

lines.en: Which is why I feed into the cycle and push back.

lines.en: Which is why she presses back again with more fervor than before.

lines.en: Which is why she continues to burn.

lines.en: Which is why-

lines.en: scene mollytrain12

lines.en: : Day one ends with your character deciding that you’ve had enough! And with mine questioning her sanity in a public restroom!

lines.zh: : 大概不是吧！不过知道您认识的人里不止我一个堕落到了这种程度，我还挺安慰的！

lines.en: : Also, now’s as good a chance as any if you want to join the club! Because either you were feeling it back there too or you have a {i}very{/i} oddly shaped wallet!

lines.zh: : 冒昧？不。危险？是的。

lines.zh: : 危险才是重点啊！

lines.en: : But even then, no one ever comes to this station! If we’re going to have our first {i}actual{/i} sexual encounter in a bathroom, this would be the one!
lines.zh: : 而且话说回来，从来没人来这个站！如果我们的第一次{i}真实{/i}性经历注定要在洗手间发生，那就是这里了！

lines.en: : Wasn’t she in your-

lines.en: : I have never met anyone who goes by that name before.

lines.en: scene mollytrain25
: You understand nothing and I was never here. Goodbye, Arakawa.
lines.zh: : 你什么都不明白，而且我从来没来过这儿。再见，Arakawa。

lines.en: scene black
Wakana drags Osako away and, after another five minutes or so, Molly returns from the restroom beet-red and sweaty.
lines.zh: Wakana 把 Osako 拖走了。又过了五分钟左右，Molly 从洗手间回来，脸红得像甜菜，浑身是汗。

lines.en: Which is, not-so-coincidentally, the same state she walked {i}into{/i} the restroom in. But I hope she was able to hold herself over for now.
lines.zh: 而这副状态，跟她{i}走进{/i}洗手间时一模一样——倒也不算巧合。不过我希望她暂时能撑住。

lines.en: Not just because it looked like she was going to burst if she had to go another five minutes without an orgasm-
lines.zh: 不只是因为看样子，她要是再五分钟没有高潮就要炸了——

lines.en: But because I am now just one more dark room and one more push away from giving her as many as her heart desires.
lines.zh: 还因为我现在只差一间暗室、再被推一把，就会把她心里想要多少就给她多少。

lines.en: The shock won’t kill me.
lines.zh: 那一下电击不会要我的命。

lines.en: And I will be okay.
lines.zh: 而我会没事的。
